today.description: The button that moves the calendar to today.

previous.description: The button that moves the calendar one month, week or day back.

next.description: The button that moves the calendar one month, week or day forward.

month.description: The option that shows the calendar a month at a time.

week.description: The option that shows the calendar a week at a time.

day.description: The option that shows the calendar a day at a time.

agenda.description: The option that shows the calendar as a list of the coming days.

untitled.description: The name of a calendar event or task that has no title.

empty.description: The text of the calendar's agenda when no event or task falls in the days it shows.

search.description: The placeholder of the calendar's search, which searches the days the calendar shows.

refresh.description: The button that fetches the days the calendar shows again.

text.description: The label of the search's text literal: the option that opens the quote and takes free text, leading the field panel.
